correctness.rationale: All faces of the dual are classified by the connected-triple criterion: N vertices, C(N,2) edges, 6N induced P3 triangles and N square tetrahedra, with no 5-faces by Mantel counting. Explicit N tetrahedron-triangle, N diagonal-triangle and 2N straight-edge-triangle free pairs leave exactly a triangulated Klein bottle plus h long edges. The Klein H1=Z+Z/2, cohomological UCT, and integral combinatorial Alexander duality yield torsion in degree N-5 and free rank h+1 in degree N-4. Independently executed Python/SymPy checker verifies all free pairs and Smith factors 1^(N-1),2 on (m,n)=(5,5),(5,6),(6,6). The finite checks are not substituted for the parameter-uniform proof.

value.rationale: Ordinary three-cut complexes are a well-motivated invariant and twisted periodic square grids form a canonical graph family. The all-parameter order-two torsion is an exact natural invariant, not a recomputation of a rational Betti number; it detects orientation twisting, obstructs shellability uniformly, and sharply contrasts with the free homology of the untwisted toroidal case. The proof identifies a reusable geometry-to-torsion mechanism rather than a numerical experiment.
